title: Size limits enforced before JSON parse prevents OOM
description: Both whois() (lines 205-207) and status() (lines 134-140) enforce maximum body size BEFORE passing bytes to serde_json::from_slice(). This is correct defensive input handling. Prevents attackers from sending megabyte responses that cause excessive memory allocation during parsing. The limits are sane: 102_400 for whois, 10MiB for status. This pattern should be maintained in all LocalAPI code.
